research.title: Europe's AI Moment
research.summary: Recorded at Morgan Stanley's European Tech, Media and Telecom Conference in Barcelona, our analysts discuss data center rollout, Europe's push for sovereign AI, the rise of agentic AI and the race for power efficiency. The episode features Paul Walsh, Head of European Research, Emmett Kelly, Head of European Telco and Data Centers, and Lee Simpson, Head of European Technology Hardware Read more insights from Morgan Stanley.

research.title: Healthcare’s next wave: AI, innovation and the future of access
research.summary: AI is reshaping drug discovery and healthcare delivery, while new medicines, medical devices and policy changes are shifting the outlook for the sector. In this episode of Making Sense, Elif Korkmaz, U.S. healthcare sector specialist at J.P. Morgan, sits down with Chris Schott, who covers U.S. Diversified Biopharma equity research, and Robbie Marcus, who covers U.S. medical supplies and device equity research. Where is innovation making the biggest difference for patients? How could AI, GLP-1 medicines and affordability shape the next wave of growth? And what should investors watch in healthcare policy, medical devices and China’s biotech industry? Tune in for a look at the trends shaping the future of healthcare.
